scope: Sampled authored story branches, barks, choices, mission definitions and hub copy. Not a full DOM/dynamic-string or IT/EN acceptance audit.

entries.english: Predictable.
Let me choose.
Every bond is a risk.
The risk is mine.

entries.source: Sono io a guidare queste mani.
entries.english: I am the one guiding these hands.

entries.source: Il calore sale verso la città.
entries.english: The heat is rising towards the city.

entries.source: Il problema non è chi ha salvato. È chi non ha interpellato.
entries.english: The problem is not who she saved. It is who she never asked.

entries.source: Un relè acceso ti rimette in piedi.
entries.english: A powered relay gets you back on your feet.
I didn't do anything.
Even worse.
More coming from the avenue!
Biological machines. Part of the same infrastructure.

entries.source: Numeri di serie. Innesti. Non sono alieni.
entries.english: Serial numbers. Implants. They are not aliens.

entries.source: Due punti di gesso. Può trovare la strada senza che io la esponga.
entries.english: Two chalk marks. She can find the way without me exposing her.
One barrier at a time.
Do not touch her.
Who are you?
They speak names they do not know.
…come back…
I saw it.
What?
I do not know.

entries.source: Pensavo che quella porta non si sarebbe mai aperta.
entries.english: I thought that door would never open.

entries.source: Il primo accesso è stabile. Ancora uno.
entries.english: The first access point is stable. One more.

entries.source: Ora teniamo aperta la rotta che hanno scelto.
entries.english: Now let's keep their chosen route open.
I can preserve you. All of you.
This part is yours!
Finish what you started.

entries.source: Lia. Il suo primo compleanno. La sua voce. I ricordi fanno una persona.
entries.english: Lia. Her first birthday. Her voice. Memories make a person.

entries.source: Un altro autobus. Aprite il cancello.
entries.english: Another bus. Open the gate.

entries.source: Nox mi ha indicato la strada.
entries.english: Nox showed me the way.
Changing route.
The way is clear.
They have lit some windows up there.

entries.source: Mappa pronta. Senza inviare la tua firma.
entries.english: Map ready. Without sending your signature.

entries.source: I segni di gesso sono ancora qui.
entries.english: The chalk marks are still here.
EVE-47 RECOVERY AUTHORIZED.

entries.source: EVE-Prime può ricordare. Non può comandare.
entries.english: EVE-Prime may remember. She may not command.
Keep the memory

entries.source: Anche il silenzio è una scelta tua.
entries.english: Silence is your choice too.
Let her switch off
Control belongs to you alone
+2 health in the descent missions.
Use it on yourself
Only one thermal cell

entries.source: Può raggiungere chi è rimasto in superficie.
entries.english: It can reach those left on the surface.
Give it to Unit 9

entries.source: Più breve, ma esposto alle pattuglie.
entries.english: Shorter, but exposed to patrols.
Direct passage

entries.source: Più riparata e accessibile a chi porta acqua.
entries.english: More sheltered and accessible to water carriers.
Service route
Which connection should we reopen first?
Because you want to now.
Take it

entries.source: La mano è lì. Nox decide.
entries.english: The hand is there. Nox decides.
You can also choose to wait.
Stay beside her
Ines has agreed to escort them.
Entrust them to Ines

entries.source: La linea resta aperta fino all’ultimo.
entries.english: The line stays open until the last person is out.
Stay with them
The last people underground
You want a part in the decision.
“Ask me first.”

entries.source: Una risposta non risolve tutte le scelte future.
entries.english: One answer does not settle every future choice.
“Choose them.”

entries.source: Se dovessi scegliere fra te e un quartiere intero?
entries.english: If I had to choose between you and a whole district?
You still keep it. Why?

entries.source: Condividi una cosa che hai scelto.
entries.english: Share something you chose.
“Because it is useless.”

entries.source: Non hai ancora una risposta da darle.
entries.english: You do not have an answer for her yet.
“I do not know yet.”

entries.source: Cathedral Market riapre. Le persone decidono insieme gli orari della corrente.
entries.english: Cathedral Market reopens. People decide the power schedule together.

entries.source: Sopra, vetrine illuminate. Sotto, un orologio batte tredici volte.
entries.english: Above, lit shop windows. Below, a clock strikes thirteen.

entries.source: Il quadrante porta un simbolo che non è di Elyon. Nessuno sa quando sia stato montato.
entries.english: The dial bears a symbol that is not Elyon's. Nobody knows when it was installed.

entries.source: Questi orologi sono più vecchi delle condotte. Non appartengono a Elyon.
entries.english: These clocks are older than the pipes. They do not belong to Elyon.

entries.source: Al porto mi hai visto scappare. Qui sto provando a ricominciare.
entries.english: You saw me fleeing at the harbour. Here I am trying to start again.

entries.source: Dietro il quadrante: un orologio spezzato inciso nella pietra.
entries.english: Behind the dial: a broken clock carved into the stone.

entries.source: Gli automi riparano i collegamenti. Nessuna voce assegna loro un padrone.
entries.english: The automata repair the connections. No voice assigns them an owner.

entries.source: Un automa ripara un altro automa con un ingranaggio impossibile.
entries.english: One automaton repairs another with an impossible gear.

entries.source: Gli orologi non seguono la stessa ora. Le loro fondamenta sono precedenti a Elyon.
entries.english: The clocks do not agree on the time. Their foundations predate Elyon.

entries.source: Ieri ho visto due uomini cadere dal cielo. Uno conosceva i colpi prima che arrivassero.
entries.english: Yesterday I saw two men fall from the sky. One knew the blows before they landed.

entries.source: L’altro aveva un’arma rumorosa. E una lama che girava. Mai visto niente del genere a Vanta.
entries.english: The other had a loud weapon. And a spinning blade. Never seen anything like it in Vanta.

entries.source: Dietro una ruota ferma, lo stesso simbolo di orologio spezzato.
entries.english: Behind a motionless wheel, the same broken-clock symbol.

entries.source: Le luci del rifugio funzionano anche quando Elyon tace.
entries.english: The shelter's lights work even when Elyon falls silent.

entries.source: La Vortex si ferma tra finestre accese e lampade a batteria.
entries.english: The Vortex stops among lit windows and battery lamps.

entries.source: Lulù lascia una tazza anche per Nox. «Lo so che non ti serve.»
entries.english: Lulù leaves a cup for Nox too. “I know you do not need it.”
“You always leave it now.”

entries.source: È quella la Vortex? La riconoscerei anche al buio.
entries.english: Is that the Vortex? I would recognise it even in the dark.

entries.source: Quel segno sui relè? Sta anche sulle vecchie porte. Non mi piace che si siano riaperte.
entries.english: That mark on the relays? It is on the old doors too. I do not like that they have reopened.

entries.source: Una biglia liscia. Nessuna funzione. Nox la fa rotolare fra le dita.
entries.english: A smooth marble. No function. Nox rolls it between his fingers.

entries.source: Il Bazaar commercia apertamente. Le pompe restano di chi le mantiene.
entries.english: The Bazaar trades openly. The pumps remain in the hands of those who maintain them.

entries.source: L’acqua corre in tubi montati a mano. Nessun cavo raggiunge Elyon.
entries.english: Water runs through hand-fitted pipes. No cable reaches Elyon.

entries.source: Una persona mutata vende filtri. Un’altra ripara una radio. Nessuno aspetta che qualcuno venga a salvarli.
entries.english: A mutated person sells filters. Another repairs a radio. Nobody is waiting for someone to save them.

entries.source: Queste mani le ho ancora. Il filtro l’ho fatto io. Vuoi vedere come?
entries.english: I still have these hands. I made that filter myself. Want to see how?

entries.source: L’Archivio legge chi lo attraversa. Isola il tuo impianto prima di entrare.
entries.english: The Archive reads whoever passes through it. Isolate your implant before you enter.

entries.source: Una stanza di manutenzione trasformata in cucina comune. Il suo interruttore non è collegato a Elyon.
entries.english: A maintenance room turned into a communal kitchen. Its switch is not connected to Elyon.
For the Axis: shield the implant, +1 damage.
Offensive shield
For the Axis: shield the implant, +2 health.
Defensive shield

entries.source: +1 danno ai colpi. Equipaggia dal bagaglio.
entries.english: +1 shot damage. Equip from your inventory.
Coil pistol
Resonance stuns for longer.
Resonance relic

entries.source: Non apre porte. Non aumenta nessun parametro.
entries.english: It opens no doors. It increases no stats.
A useless object

entries.source: Segna la stanza nascosta di questo quartiere.
entries.english: Marks this district's hidden room.
Niche map

entries.source: Recupera 4 salute durante una missione. Non si rigenera dopo una sconfitta.
entries.english: Restores 4 health during a mission. It is not replenished after defeat.
Medicine

entries.source: +2 danno; colpi più lenti. Equipaggia dal bagaglio.
entries.english: +2 damage; slower shots. Equip from your inventory.
Portable resonator
For the Archive: isolate the implant, +1 damage.
Offensive isolation
For the Archive: isolate the implant, +2 health.
Defensive isolation

entries.source: +2 salute a ogni ingresso in missione.
entries.english: +2 health whenever you enter a mission.
Reinforced jacket

entries.source: La custode vuole confrontare tre quadranti che segnano ore diverse.
entries.english: The custodian wants to compare three clock faces showing different times.

entries.source: I quadranti discordano di un secondo. Poi tornano immobili.
entries.english: The clock faces disagree by one second. Then they become still again.
Survey the clocks

entries.source: Riapri due cancelli per far tornare il mercato del porto.
entries.english: Reopen two gates to bring back the harbour market.

entries.source: Il commerciante del porto riapre il banco. Ricorderà chi ha liberato la strada.
entries.english: The harbour merchant reopens his stall. He will remember who cleared the way.
Open the passage

entries.source: La meccanica prepara un innesto. Riallinea tre distributori.
entries.english: The mechanic prepares an implant. Realign three distributors.

entries.source: I collegamenti tornano attivi. Un componente schermato è pronto.
entries.english: The connections are working again. A shielded component is ready.
Repair the connections

entries.source: Sblocca due passerelle laterali prima di salire all’Asse.
entries.english: Unlock two side walkways before climbing to the Axis.

entries.source: La via di fuga è pronta. La meccanica ti offre un secondo componente.
entries.english: The escape route is ready. The mechanic offers you a second component.
Open an escape route

entries.source: Mira cerca tre accumulatori: sono nelle nicchie del rifugio.
entries.english: Mira needs three power cells: they are in the shelter's alcoves.

entries.source: Tre finestre tornano accese. La bambina saluta la Vortex.
entries.english: Three windows light up again. The girl waves at the Vortex.
Relight the lamps

entries.source: Dario presta gli attrezzi. Sigilla due condotte e torna al fabbro.
entries.english: Dario lends you tools. Seal two pipes and return to the smith.

entries.source: La locanda apre una stanza asciutta per chi arriva dal Cantiere.
entries.english: The inn opens a dry room for people arriving from the Works.
Repair the roof

entries.source: Segna due ponti sicuri per chi non può attraversare l’acqua.
entries.english: Mark two safe bridges for those who cannot cross the water.

entries.source: Il mercato apre il percorso. Un secondo componente è pronto in officina.
entries.english: The market opens the route. A second component is ready in the workshop.
Mark the dry route

entries.source: L’alchimista ti presta una chiave: riattiva tre pompe autonome.
entries.english: The alchemist lends you a wrench: restart three independent pumps.

entries.source: L’acqua riparte senza Elyon. Il fabbro ti consegna un componente isolato.
entries.english: The water runs again without Elyon. The smith hands you an isolated component.
Repair the pumps
Beneath the Clinical District

entries.source: L’archivio tace. La cosa che ti parlava dall’interno non ha più le tue mani.
entries.english: The Archive falls silent. The thing that spoke inside you no longer controls your hands.

entries.source: Leggi i 3 archivi, poi affronta EVE-Prime
entries.english: Read the 3 archives, then face EVE-Prime
08 · EVE Archive
ARCHIVE
Read the archives
Spore echoes
Orbital Axis

entries.source: La piattaforma dell’asse. In cima qualcuno ti aspetta. Non è Lulù.
entries.english: The Axis platform. Someone is waiting at the top. It is not Lulù.
Unlock the 3 Axis lifts
10 · Ascent
LIFT
Unlock the lifts
Lower Levels

entries.source: Il calore torna nelle mani. Sopra di te, qualcosa nel Nodo si raffredda.
entries.english: Warmth returns to your hands. Above you, something in the Node cools down.
Open the 3 thermal valves
05 · Beneath the Node
VALVE
Open the valves
Elyon's guides
East Works

entries.source: Le uscite si aprono. Il relè ha riconosciuto Nox prima che inserisse un codice.
entries.english: The exits open. The relay recognised Nox before he entered a code.

entries.source: Riaccendi i 3 relè, poi affronta Rook
entries.english: Restore the 3 relays, then face Rook
01 · Blackout
RELAY
Power the relays
Relay Gang
Antenna Harbour

entries.source: La breccia cede. Le creature non erano aliene: portavano numeri di serie più vecchi della città.
entries.english: The breach collapses. The creatures were not aliens: they bore serial numbers older than the city.

entries.source: Chiudi le 3 ancore, poi ferma The Anchor
entries.english: Shut down the 3 anchors, then stop The Anchor
02 · The Breach
ANCHOR
Shut down the anchors
Breach predators

entries.source: Il generatore riparte. Il quartiere torna a fare rumore.
entries.english: The generator starts again. The district makes noise again.

entries.source: Difendi il cancello finché torna la corrente
entries.english: Defend the gate until the power returns
06 · The City Without You
Clinical District

entries.source: Il corridoio è aperto. Sotto l’asfalto qualcosa ha sentito il tuo nome.
entries.english: The corridor is open. Something beneath the asphalt has heard your name.

entries.source: Attiva i 3 filtri, apri il corridoio
entries.english: Activate the 3 filters and open the corridor
03 · Last Ward
FILTER
Activate the filters
Infected
Harbour

entries.source: Il gesso continua oltre la riparazione. Gli abitanti attraversano da soli.
entries.english: The chalk trail continues beyond the repair. Residents cross on their own.

entries.source: Riattiva i due accessi, poi proteggi il collegamento
entries.english: Reactivate both access points, then protect the connection
Chalk Marks
ACCESS
Open the access points
Maintenance patrols
Axis Platform

entries.source: Archon si spegne. Per la prima volta da centosettantotto anni, l’asse è in silenzio.
entries.english: Archon shuts down. For the first time in a hundred and seventy-eight years, the Axis is silent.

entries.source: Spegni le 3 ancore dell’asse, poi Archon
entries.english: Shut down the 3 Axis anchors, then Archon
11 · Hour One
Shut down the anchors
Archon

entries.source: Gli autobus partono. Dietro di loro, la collina è vuota.
entries.english: The buses leave. Behind them, the hill is empty.

entries.source: Tieni la linea finché partono gli autobus
entries.english: Hold the line until the buses leave
09 · The Line
Custodians

entries.source: Tre antenne in ascolto. Il porto non si è accorto di niente, o quasi.
entries.english: Three antennas listening. The harbour has not noticed a thing. Almost.

entries.source: Raggiungi le 3 antenne senza farti vedere
entries.english: Reach the 3 antennas without being seen
07 · Dark Harbour
ANTENNA
Reach the antennas
Central Node

entries.source: Il Custode cade. Nel suo nucleo c’è un registro con il tuo nome.
entries.english: The Custodian falls. Inside its core is a record bearing your name.

entries.source: Spegni i 3 nuclei, abbatti il Custode
entries.english: Shut down the 3 cores and defeat the Custodian
04 · Hour Zero
CORE
Shut down the cores
Fracture Custodians

entries.source: TRASFERIMENTO DI COSCIENZA SENZA CONSENSO: DISABILITATO
entries.english: CONSCIOUSNESS TRANSFER WITHOUT CONSENT: DISABLED
COERCIVE CONTROL OF UNITS: DISABLED

entries.source: Elyon continua ad alimentare Vanta. Non può più possedere chi la abita.
entries.english: Elyon continues to power Vanta. It can no longer own the people who live there.

entries.source: La città deve imparare a scegliere insieme.
entries.english: The city must learn to choose together.

entries.source: Se sai quale azione funziona, perché esiti?
entries.english: If you know which action works, why hesitate?
Because working is not the same as choosing.
EVE-PRIME MOTOR CONTROL REVOKED

entries.source: Due punti di gesso sulle botole. Qualcuno ha tenuto aperta la strada.
entries.english: Two chalk marks on the hatches. Someone kept the way open.
I am EVE-Prime. I followed orders.

entries.source: Un ordine causò la morte di Lia. La figlia della creatrice di Elyon.
entries.english: An order caused Lia’s death. The daughter of Elyon’s creator.

entries.source: E adesso vuoi scegliere anche per me.
entries.english: And now you want to choose for me as well.

entries.source: Voglio proteggerti. Senza relazioni non dovrai più rischiare.
entries.english: I want to protect you. Without relationships, you would never have to risk anything again.

entries.source: Raggiungi l’Asse. Un ascensore alla volta.
entries.english: Reach the Axis. One lift at a time.
May I warn you before they strike?
Yes. Warn me.

entries.source: Una cella termica intatta. Accanto, Unità 9, immobile nel freddo.
entries.english: An intact thermal cell. Beside it, Unit 9, motionless in the cold.
Let me handle it.

entries.source: Le valvole termiche sono tre. Posso aprirle io.
entries.english: There are three thermal valves. I can open them.
I said no.

entries.source: Resta energia per un solo luogo: officina o rifugio.
entries.english: There is only enough power for one place: the workshop or the shelter.
I'll take lamps to the other one.

entries.source: Tre relè. Riaccendiamoli e apriamo le uscite.
entries.english: Three relays. Let's power them and open the exits.

entries.source: Tu le persone. Io la gang.
entries.english: You take the people. I take the gang.
A fracture above the harbour.

entries.source: Le ancore la tengono aperta. Chiudiamole.
entries.english: The anchors are holding it open. Let us shut them down.

entries.source: Posso trasmettere la tua firma. Avremmo subito una mappa completa.
entries.english: I can transmit your signature. We would have a complete map straight away.
No.
All right.
DURING THE SEPARATION · HARBOUR

entries.source: Un abitante ridisegna il segno oltre la riparazione.
entries.english: A resident redraws the mark beyond the repair.

entries.source: Il passaggio diretto regge. Adesso passiamo noi.
entries.english: The direct passage holds. We'll cross now.

entries.source: La rotta riparata regge. Adesso passiamo noi.
entries.english: The repaired route holds. We'll cross now.
The trail is yours.

entries.source: Nox vede il gesso attraversare il passaggio diretto riaperto. Una persona lo segue con una borraccia.
entries.english: Nox sees chalk crossing the reopened direct passage. Someone follows it with a water flask.

entries.source: Nox vede il gesso piegare verso la giuntura riparata. Una persona segue la rotta di servizio con una borraccia.
entries.english: Nox sees chalk turning towards the repaired joint. Someone follows the service route with a water flask.
Someone reopened this passage.

entries.source: Da lì passa chi porta l’acqua. Da qui chi non può fare le scale.
entries.english: Water carriers use that way. People who can't climb stairs use this one.
I can open the direct passage.

entries.source: Lo so. Prima ascolta chi deve usarlo.
entries.english: I know. First listen to the people who use it.
Then show me which way you go.

entries.source: Il generatore riparte. Aprite quando siete pronti.
entries.english: The generator is running. Open up when you are ready.

entries.source: La gang è tornata. Sanno che siamo al buio.
entries.english: The gang is back. They know we are in the dark.

entries.source: Tenete le porte chiuse. Porto la luce.
entries.english: Keep the doors shut. I will bring the light.
DOOR OPEN · 19 CIVILIANS EXITING
EVE-47 LOCATED

entries.source: Siamo in diciannove! L’aria sta finendo!
entries.english: There are nineteen of us! We are running out of air!

entries.source: PARATIA CHIUSA · NOX SUL LATO ESTERNO · COMUNICAZIONI INTERROTTE
entries.english: BULKHEAD CLOSED · NOX ON THE OUTSIDE · COMMUNICATIONS LOST
HELIOS DOOR · EVE AUTHENTICATION AVAILABLE

entries.source: ATTENZIONE — L’AUTENTICAZIONE RIVELERÀ LA POSIZIONE DELL’UNITÀ.
entries.english: WARNING — AUTHENTICATION WILL REVEAL THE UNIT’S LOCATION.

entries.source: Nox combatte dall’altra parte. Non può sentirmi.
entries.english: Nox is fighting on the other side. He cannot hear me.

entries.source: La corona temporale si spezza. Ingranaggi, vetro ed energia viola si disperdono.
entries.english: The temporal crown shatters. Gears, glass and violet energy scatter.

entries.source: Nell’ultimo nucleo, per un istante, un ricordo di Lia.
entries.english: In the final core, for an instant, a memory of Lia.
Let me go.

entries.source: Elena smette di combattere. Il nucleo si spegne.
entries.english: Elena stops fighting. The core goes dark.

entries.source: La spora porta ricordi. Gli infetti pronunciano nomi che non conoscono.
entries.english: The spores carry memories. The infected speak names they do not know.

entries.source: Anch’io li vedo. Non sono miei.
entries.english: I see them too. They are not mine.
Brake earlier at the next turn.
You say that at every turn.
Because I know how you drive.

entries.source: Mira ha aperto una strada secondaria.
entries.english: Mira opened a side road.

entries.source: Dario ha rinforzato la Vortex. Un urto in più non la ferma.
entries.english: Dario reinforced the Vortex. It can take another hit.

entries.source: Diciannove persone. Fermati ai due punti di raccolta.
entries.english: Nineteen people. Stop at both collection points.
I will get them out.

entries.source: Puoi ricordare. Non puoi comandare il mio corpo.
entries.english: You may remember. You may not control my body.
You can let go.

entries.source: Questi ricordi potrebbero essere tuoi. Potresti essere lei.
entries.english: These memories could be yours. You could be her.
I am here.

entries.source: Nox estrae il frammento di vetro. La prima cosa inutile che abbia scelto di tenere.
entries.english: Nox takes out the piece of glass. The first useless thing he chose to keep.
That means nothing.
Exactly.

entries.source: Mi chiamavo Elena Voss. Ho costruito Elyon.
entries.english: My name was Elena Voss. I built Elyon.

entries.source: La tua è una linea di unità sintetiche. Non ti ho creata per essere Lia.
entries.english: You belong to a line of synthetic units. I did not create you to be Lia.

entries.source: Ma sei compatibile con l’ultima copia incompleta della sua mente.
entries.english: But you are compatible with the last incomplete copy of her mind.

entries.source: Posso restituirti centosettantotto anni di memoria.
entries.english: I can give you back a hundred and seventy-eight years of memory.
They are not mine.
They could be.
I need it to keep going.
Why?

entries.source: Qualcuno ha aperto una cassa per me.
entries.english: Someone opened a crate for me.
EIGHT MONTHS LATER · VANTA · NIGHT
Your cup is there.
I don't drink.

entries.source: Otto mesi che me lo dici. Otto mesi che la lascio.
entries.english: You've told me for eight months. I've left it there for eight months.
You're afraid.
I'm just checking the route.

entries.source: La controlli tre volte quando hai paura.
entries.english: You check it three times when you are afraid.
Every window goes dark.

entries.source: Gli autobus sono pieni. Posso accompagnare gli ultimi, oppure puoi restare con noi.
entries.english: The buses are full. I can escort the last people, or you can stay with us.
Will you go with them?
Yes. Go.

entries.source: Gli autobus partono a breve. C’è gente ancora nei sotterranei.
entries.english: The buses leave soon. People are still underground.

entries.source: Chiedi a chi può muoversi dove vuole andare. Io tengo la linea.
entries.english: Ask those who can move where they want to go. I will hold the line.
I will stay until the last person is out.
TRANSMISSION POSSIBLE
RECIPIENT CAN BE LOCATED DURING TRANSMISSION
Lulù switches off the terminal.

entries.source: Se torna, deve essere perché ha scelto di farlo.
entries.english: If she comes back, it must be because she chose to.

entries.source: Tre antenne. Evita le pattuglie e apri il canale.
entries.english: Three antennas. Avoid the patrols and open the channel.

entries.source: DOPO I TITOLI · CLOCKWORK OUTPOST · PIOGGIA
entries.english: AFTER THE CREDITS · CLOCKWORK OUTPOST · RAIN

entries.source: Dimmi almeno che quella cosa sa riportarci a casa.
entries.english: Tell me at least that thing can get us home.
Someone opened a door.

entries.source: E il libro può riportarci nel nostro tempo?
entries.english: And the book can take us back to our own time?
If we find it.
Then let us find the book.

entries.source: Per un istante, un altro cielo appare sopra Vanta.
entries.english: For an instant, another sky appears above Vanta.
CHRONOS CONTINUES · CHRONO SHADOWS

entries.source: Nel frammento è nascosta una pagina: città, epoche, mondi. Al centro un libro e dodici simboli.
entries.english: A page is hidden inside the fragment: cities, eras, worlds. At its centre, a book and twelve symbols.
What is it?
THE BOOK OF BROKEN HOURS

entries.source: OGNI MONDO HA UN’ORA CHE NON DOVREBBE ESISTERE.
entries.english: EVERY WORLD HAS AN HOUR THAT SHOULD NOT EXIST.

entries.source: Quindi siamo stati trascinati qui per errore?
entries.english: So we were dragged here by mistake?
I do not think so.
Worse?
I do not forgive you.
I did not ask you to.
Come anyway.

entries.source: Alla base dell’Asse, Lulù consegna il terminale a Nox.
entries.english: At the foot of the Axis, Lulù hands Nox the terminal.
You can read everything.
I do not need everything.

entries.source: A me serviva smettere di scegliere cosa potevi sapere.
entries.english: I needed to stop choosing what you were allowed to know.
May I come with you?

entries.source: Non so se mi fido ancora.
entries.english: I do not know if I trust you yet.
But come with me.

entries.source: Sì. Ma chiedimelo anche la prossima volta.
entries.english: Yes. But ask me next time too.

entries.source: Iron Ring. Un camion senza nessuno al posto accanto.
entries.english: Iron Ring. A maintenance truck with an empty seat beside me.

entries.source: I droni segnalano la corsia prima di colpire.
entries.english: The drones mark a lane before they strike.

entries.source: A cosa serve ancora quel pezzo di vetro?
entries.english: What is that piece of glass still good for?
Nothing.
Lulù smiles.

entries.source: È per questo che lo tengo.
entries.english: That is why I keep it.

entries.source: Lulù tende la mano. Non prende quella di Nox. La lascia lì.
entries.english: Lulù holds out her hand. She does not take Nox’s. She leaves it there.

entries.source: Nox cade nei livelli inferiori. Lulù resta dall’altra parte.
entries.english: Nox falls into the lower levels. Lulù remains on the other side.
SIGNATURE USED: EVE-47
TRANSMISSION AUTHORIZED BY: LULÙ
STRUCTURAL FAILURE
Did you know they could find me?
Yes.
And you did it.

entries.source: Sì. Diciannove persone stavano morendo. Ho scelto di salvarle.
entries.english: Yes. Nineteen people were dying. I chose to save them.
By using me.
I could have told you to do it.
But I did not ask you.

entries.source: Restiamo locali. Tre segnali e traccio la rotta.
entries.english: We stay local. Three signals and I can plot the route.
Without transmitting me.

entries.source: Se trovi questo simbolo, non aprire niente.
entries.english: If you find this symbol, do not open anything.
Because we did.

entries.source: Nox prende il frammento metallico. Un orologio spezzato.
entries.english: Nox takes the metal fragment. A broken clock.

entries.source: Dimmi che almeno tu sai dove siamo.
entries.english: Tell me at least you know where we are.
Then that makes three of us.
Finally, something simple.

entries.source: Il tunnel è al buio. La Risonanza legge la strada a impulsi.
entries.english: The tunnel is dark. Resonance reads the road in pulses.
I have to get these people to the exit.

entries.source: Ignorano tutti gli altri. Vogliono me.
entries.english: They ignore everyone else. They want me.
The cores first, then the Custodian.
